title: When the Garden Burns Anew
author: Ulyana Nakamura
blurb: Juniper Yarrow, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the long winter finishes falling.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
